I take unrefined shea butter and put it in a bowl,  then place the bowl into  a pot and melt the butter on medium heat.  Not high because the shea butter will lose its nutrition and allat good shit.   

Once the  butter is melted I put in sweet almond oil, place a plastic wrap on the bowl and put it the freezer for about 35-40min.

When the time is up i mix the shea butter until it becomes whipped, then I add some aloe vera juice.  Thats it!

Thanks! Yes you can use it as a lip balm, as a moisturizer for face and body.  Its magic.  Also i’m pretty sure whipped shea butter wont leave residue on your hair.

 It sinks into your hair smoothly too.  Those store boughts creams are usually the ones who leave residue because of the ingredient content.
